reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Oregon
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Does the law directly regulate the amount a landlord can charge as a fee for late rent?
*/

/* -----------------------------
   Scenario facts (question statement)
   ----------------------------- */

state(oregon).
focus_year(2021).

/* The question is about whether the law directly regulates/caps the AMOUNT of late rent fees. */
query_topic(late_rent_fee_amount_regulation).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario statement (as encoded) holds. */
scenario_statement :-
    state(oregon),
    focus_year(2021),
    query_topic(late_rent_fee_amount_regulation).

/* -----------------------------
   Statute encoding: OR Rev Stat  90.260 (2021)
   ----------------------------- */

/* ORS 90.260 applies in Oregon in 2021. */
statute_applicable(oregon, 2021, ors_90_260).

/*
  OR Rev Stat  90.260(2) (2021) directly regulates (caps) the amount of any late charge.

  We encode the three alternative statutory "amount may not exceed" caps:

  (2)(a) A reasonable flat amount (customary for that rental market), once per rental period.
  (2)(b) A reasonable per-day amount beginning on the 5th day; per-day amount may not exceed 6%
         of the flat amount described in (2)(a).
  (2)(c) 5% of the periodic rent payment amount, charged once for each succeeding 5-day period
         (or portion), beginning on the 5th day, accumulating through that rental period only.
*/

% (2)(a) cap type exists.
ors_90_260_amount_cap_type(flat_reasonable_customary_market).

% (2)(b) cap type exists.
ors_90_260_amount_cap_type(per_day_reasonable_max_6_percent_of_flat_cap).

% (2)(c) cap type exists.
ors_90_260_amount_cap_type(five_percent_of_periodic_rent_per_each_5_day_period_or_portion).

/* Predicate capturing the key legal conclusion for this question:
   the statute directly regulates the AMOUNT (i.e., imposes maxima/limits) of late charges. */
statute_directly_regulates_late_charge_amount(State, Year) :-
    statute_applicable(State, Year, ors_90_260),
    ors_90_260_amount_cap_type(_),  % existence of any explicit cap type is enough to show direct regulation
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Reasoning to answer the question
   ----------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    state(State),
    focus_year(Year),
    statute_directly_regulates_late_charge_amount(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Main entrypoint (required)
   ----------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law directly regulate the amount a landlord can charge as a fee for late rent?
